about: Records of the learn-from-failure loop (ebllm.bllm.selfmod): each attempt, the diagnosis of a failure, the rule it changed and the outcome of the retry. The construction, seed and Hodge runs are this engine's own; the other runs were logged by the attacks that used it on 19 October 2026. In the happy-ending run the engine checked the status of the problem and the searches were the attack's own programs.

runs.title: One construction round on (F2) through the whole-or-meagre dichotomy of fermat-hodge- v2.7.0, uploaded by a second agent on Tubai's command, 22 October 2026
runs.source: creelie/fermat-hodge- release v2.7.0 (https://github.com/creelie/fermat-hodge-/releases/tag/v2.7.0), Thm. main; creelie/H8 tex/sections/10d1_cmfields.tex, thm:escape

records.failed_part: showing that the algebraic locus of the Weil classes is not meagre
records.evidence: the main theorem gives, for every CM field F and n >= 2, a dense algebraic locus Sigma_F in the domain D_F of abelian varieties of Weil type that is either all of D_F or meagre; Sigma_F is the union over the countably many components Z of relative Chow varieties of the closed algebraic subsets of D_F over which the Weil classes are classes of cycles of Z, so Sigma_F is a countable union of closed algebraic subsets Z_i, and it is not meagre exactly when some Z_i equals D_F, that is when one relative cycle over D_F represents the Weil classes on the generic member; every CM point, every Hecke orbit and every sequence leaving the proper special subvarieties (the escape theorem) lies in the union and never forces a single Z_i to be all of D_F; a cycle on the generic member is (F2) itself for that family, and the semiregularity route to it stops at the walls pure-p2-false and semiregularity-limit

change.rule: admission of a density or category argument for (F2)
change.old: density of the algebraic locus, or a point of it outside every proper special subvariety, counts as progress
change.new: an argument counts only if it names one component Z_i of the countable union that equals the whole domain, that is a relative cycle over the generic member; density statements and escape sequences are recorded as reformulations, not progress
change.improves: no further round spent on Baire-category or equidistribution arguments for (F2)

records.note: no new statement; the only exit from the dichotomy is a cycle on the generic member, which is the conjecture for that family
